text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spot Vodka in the library of<n>all places.
She's even got a book<n>open...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
AAAAAAGH! None of this theory<n>junk makes
SENSE!
choice_data_list: Hey, Vodka. You need some help?
Hey, Vodka. You need some help?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey, Trainer. The thing is...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You can't be serious! Do you realize<n>how many
people are going to be<n>watching?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Course I do! That's why I'm gonna<n>show 'em all
who's the coolest!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...You're just worrying over dumb<n>details, like
always.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...And now that I've gone and stirred<n>her up, I'm
never gonna hear the end<n>of it if I blow this.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I've gotta lock in and show Scarlet<n>who's boss!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what they're bickering<n>over this time,
but Vodka's gonna<n>have an easier time picking up
running tricks on the track.
choice_data_list:
I think you've had enough of the books. Let's do
some laps.

I think you've had enough of the books. Let's do
some laps.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Ohhh, I hear ya! I hadn't thought of<n>that!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You're not a trainer for nothin', huh?<n>C'mon, let's
go!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Panting... NOW I feel like I'm movin'up!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whew! I owe ya one, Trainer. Runnin'<n>wild
definitely suits me better than all<n>that book
gibberish about manners.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna crush the holiday party<n>tonight!
choice_data_list: The... holiday party?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the one they're holding by the<n>station. Scarlet
and I got invited.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I was trying to read up on tablemanners and all that junk, but man.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's all so damn pretentious, and that<n>just ain't me!
You were right, I'm<n>better off bein' myself—just
like<n>running!
choice_data_list: Wait, wait, WAIT! I didn't realize you were studying for a party!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: All right, all right. I've got a hang ofthe polite greetings and stuff, sogimme a break...
choice_data_list:
Already? I thought you wanted to show everyone
how cool you are.

Already? I thought you wanted to show everyone
how cool you are.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeah, but I'll be fiiine. Trust me!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm all dressed up fancy-like, and you<n>helped me
practice talkin' all polite.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And most of all, you made me<n>remember what
makes me the<n>coolest!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I've got this party in the bag!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
By sheer luck, my misreading the<n>situation seems
to have given Vodka<n>the spark she was missing.
choice_data_list: Gotcha. Go show 'em who's the coolest!
Gotcha. Go show 'em who's the coolest!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Heck yeah!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for all the help. I'm glad I've<n>got you
comin' with me tonight.
choice_data_list: ...Huh? Wait, since when?! I'm not prepared at all!
...Huh? Wait, since when?! I'm not prepared at all!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Meh, you can just wing it, eaaasy!You're my Trainer after all!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well, well. And here I thought you'd<n>be a nervous
wreck at a formal<n>gathering like this.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You're acting surprisingly normal. At<n>least that's
one less thing for me to<n>worry about.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Haaang on! What do you mean,"normal"?! I'm bein' extra cool!Look!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The two of them are competitive as<n>ever, but the
way they bounce off<n>each other livens up the party
a lot!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
By sheer luck, my misreading the<n>situation seems
to have given Vodka<n>the spark she was missing.
choice_data_list: Gotcha. Go show 'em who's the coolest!
Gotcha. Go show 'em who's the coolest!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Heck yeah!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for all the help. I'm glad I've<n>got you
comin' with me tonight.
choice_data_list: ...Huh? Wait, since when?! I'm not prepared at all!
...Huh? Wait, since when?! I'm not prepared at all!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Oh NO! AAAAA, I'm sorry, I<n>was so focused,
I completely forgot<n>to tell you! C'mon, hurry and get
changed!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, someway... we make it to<n>the party on
time, and bumble our<n>way through the pleasantries
without<n>too much issue.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
By sheer luck, my misreading the<n>situation seems
to have given Vodka<n>the spark she was missing.
choice_data_list: Gotcha. Go be the coolest you've ever been!
Gotcha. Go be the coolest you've ever been!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: What, even cooler than I already am?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! You're on! I'll show ya just<n>how much I've
grown!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After that, we head out to the party.<n>Vodka and
Scarlet butt heads as<n>usual, but Vodka handles the
formalities astonishingly well.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So, how was I? Extra cool, just like I<n>said I'd be,
right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You were... normal, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean, "normal"?! I<n>practiced a TON for
this!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Good for you. But you were still just<n>totally
average. Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: AVERAGE?! You take that back!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Even after the party's over, the two<n>keep things
lively the whole way<n>back.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
By sheer luck, my misreading the<n>situation seems
to have given Vodka<n>the spark she was missing.
choice_data_list: Gotcha. I know you can be even cooler!
Gotcha. I know you can be even cooler!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: What, even cooler than I already am?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! You're on! I'll show ya just<n>how much I've
grown!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After that, we head out to the party.<n>Vodka and
Scarlet butt heads as<n>usual, but Vodka handles the
formalities astonishingly well.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I totally nailed that party, but whew,<n>I'm
exhausted...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Focusing so hard on etiquette ends<n>up draining
Vodka, but I think the<n>party was a great experience
for her!
